title: Shanghai Aerogelzone Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Shanghai Aerogelzone Technology Co., Ltd. is a Shanghai-based aerogel supplier focused on export-ready silica aerogel products and customized insulation solutions. Its portfolio spans raw aerogel additives, industrial and building insulation systems, and EV battery thermal-barrier products.

Company Overview

Aerogelzone markets a broad range of silica aerogel products for industrial insulation, building construction, and electric-vehicle battery safety. The company’s public site emphasizes export service, custom development, and certification-oriented manufacturing.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Global export markets.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, building insulation, EV battery thermal barriers, and custom aerogel material development.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Silica aerogel powder and particles
  • High-temperature and cryogenic aerogel blankets
  • Basalt-fiber blankets and aerogel panels
  • Ultra-high-temperature panels, thin battery thermal barriers, and aerogel tube shells
  • Public Capacity: Not clearly disclosed on the reviewed pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: 518 Nianjiabang Road, Pudong, Shanghai 201318, China.
  • International Certifications: ASTM-compliant positioning plus publicly displayed ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and SGS/ASTM-related test documents.
  • Official Website: https://aerogelzone.com
